com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.model

Class MetricsConfiguration

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.model.MetricsConfiguration
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SdkPojo, ToCopyableBuilder<MetricsConfiguration.Builder,MetricsConfiguration>, Serializable

    @Generated(value="com.ibm.cos.v2:codegen")
public final class MetricsConfiguration
extends Object
implements SdkPojo, Serializable, ToCopyableBuilder<MetricsConfiguration.Builder,MetricsConfiguration>

    Specifies a metrics configuration for the CloudWatch request metrics (specified by the metrics configuration ID) from an Amazon S3 bucket. If you're updating an existing metrics configuration, note that this is a full replacement of the existing metrics configuration. If you don't include the elements you want to keep, they are erased. For more information, see PutBucketMetricsConfiguration.

      • id

        public final String id()

        The ID used to identify the metrics configuration. The ID has a 64 character limit and can only contain letters, numbers, periods, dashes, and underscores.

        Returns:
        The ID used to identify the metrics configuration. The ID has a 64 character limit and can only contain letters, numbers, periods, dashes, and underscores.

      • filter

        public final MetricsFilter filter()

        Specifies a metrics configuration filter. The metrics configuration will only include objects that meet the filter's criteria. A filter must be a prefix, an object tag, an access point ARN, or a conjunction (MetricsAndOperator).

        Returns:
        Specifies a metrics configuration filter. The metrics configuration will only include objects that meet the filter's criteria. A filter must be a prefix, an object tag, an access point ARN, or a conjunction (MetricsAndOperator).
